focus: Game Ready: Closeouts, Shooting and Pack Line Shell
tagline: Force middle. Close out short. Talk on every pass.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: We scrimmage at 5:00, so tonight is about being game ready. Two things changed from September, say them out loud: one pass away we do NOT deny anymore, we sit in the gap. On the ball we force him MIDDLE, never baseline. Two non-negotiables: you move on the flight of the pass, and you talk every possession. Split Team 1 / Team 2 for the tally.

visual.coach: Head coach in the center of the circle. Say the scrimmage plan and the two changes out loud. Assistants set out cones for the pack line during warmup.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup only, baseline to half court and back: jog, high knees, butt kicks, carioca both ways, walking lunge with a twist, leg swings, defensive slides, then two build-up sprints. Captains lead it and call each move. This gets the legs ready for 5:00.

visual.coach: Sideline at half court. Captains run it. Coaches watch for effort and get the cones out on the pack line.

items.title: Pack Line Shell: Stage 1 to 2
items.note: 2 minutes on the board, 12 on the floor. Pack line is 16 feet from the rim. BALL shades baseline and forces middle. GAP sits on the line between his man and the ball. HELP has feet in the lane. 5 on 5, coaches fill in on offense. Stage 1, 5 minutes: no dribble, two count on every catch, defense jumps on the flight of the pass. Freeze after any pass: every defender on his spot is 1 point, anyone late and the group runs a down and back. Stage 2, 7 minutes: game speed, defense calls Ball and Help on every pass or the rep does not count.

visual.coach: Assistants play offense in the left wing and right corner (A, B). Head coach stands above the left slot where he can see all five defenders: yell freeze after a pass, ask one guy his job, award the points.

items.title: Vegas Closeouts
items.note: Defender starts in help with the ball, passes to the wing and closes out: sprint the first two-thirds, short chop steps, get low, two hands up. Shade him baseline so he has to go middle into the help. Offense gets 2 dribbles. Drive goes baseline and the defense loses the rep. Games to 3, winner runs the Victory Lap.

visual.coach: Assistant stands in the gap (Gap) as the help, so the drive middle runs into him. Head coach watches the last three steps: chop, low, two hands up, top foot high.

items.title: Closeout Shooting
items.note: Pairs at both baskets. Partner passes from under the rim and Vegas closes out. Shooter reads it: short closeout, shoot it. Hard closeout, one dribble middle into a pull up. 5 shots, then switch. A 3 counts 2, a pull up counts 1. Top pair runs the Victory Lap. Game shots at game speed.

visual.coach: Head coach at the top of the key between both pairs: call out bad closeouts (flying by, hands down) and keep the pair scores. Assistants rebound and run the far basket pairs.

items.title: Kentucky Shooting
items.note: 3 lines of 3, middle up and half court. Pass, catch, shoot at game speed. Feet set before the catch. Every make, the line calls it out. This is our last shooting before tip.

visual.label: Three lines at half court. Wings fill, middle drives up.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline calling the rotation. Assistant under the rim rebounding and feeding the ball back out.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name before every attempt. Round 1 any miss and the whole team runs a down and back together. Round 2 Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally and name the day's champion. Then the scrimmage plan: I grade three things, force middle, move on the pass, talk. We count turnovers and baseline drives. Break the huddle at 5:00.

visual.coach: Head coach off the lane with the tally. Count it out loud, then give the three things we grade in the scrimmage and break the huddle at 5:00. Assistants grab the stat sheet for the four numbers.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 finishing from the block, winner stays on, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Full Court Layup Competition
extras.note: 2 minutes if we finish early. Drive layups then a 3 pointer, team score. Beat the team record and everyone runs the Victory Lap together.

focus: Pack Line Shell: Help and Recover
tagline: Help stops the drive. Recover on the kick. Cut after you pass.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Three things before we start. Captains: I am picking captains this week. I am looking for who talks, who works when nobody is watching, and who shows up every day. Write down two names, not yourself, and hand them to me after practice. I make the final call and announce them Thursday. Union: the Union college teams are here next week. Who is interested? Raise your hand and I will get you the details. Practice: we have 8. One guy missing means nobody gets 4v4, and every practice builds on the last one. Today builds on Sunday. If you cannot be here, tell me before, not after. Then today: Sunday was Ball, Gap, Help. Today the ball moves and we help and recover. Two non-negotiables: move on the flight of the pass, and talk every possession. Winners run is on. Split Team 1 / Team 2. Station groups today: Shooters and Fundamentals.

visual.coach: Head coach in the middle: captains, Union next week (count the hands), why practice matters, then the focus. Assistants hand out scrap paper and pencils for the captain votes and set the cones.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup only, baseline to half court and back. Jog, high knees, butt kicks, carioca both ways, walking lunge with a twist, leg swings, defensive slides, two build-up sprints. Two guys I pick lead it and call each move. Captains take it over once we name them.

visual.coach: Two players I pick run it. Head coach on the sideline watching effort. Assistants finish the cones and grab the pads for stations.

items.title: Teach: Pack Line Shell Stages 2 and 3
items.note: 2 minutes on the board, 10 on the floor. Stage 2: ball moves, defense jumps to Ball, Gap, Help on the flight of every pass. Stage 3: offense drives middle. Help steps up and stops him, everyone sinks one spot. On the kick out, help sprints back and closes out short. Walk it first, then speed. I yell freeze and ask one guy his job. Late rotation, group runs a down and back.

visual.label: Drive middle, gap helps, kick out, gap recovers.
visual.coach: Assistant B fills the right corner on offense. Assistant A at the board for the first 2 minutes, then sits a wing when we need a fifth. Head coach above the top of the key: freeze, ask, grade the rotation.

items.title: Skill Stations, Round 1
items.note: Two groups today: Shooters at the main basket, Fundamentals at the far basket. Shooters: Read the Screen Shooting. The chair is the screen. Passer calls POP, CURL or FADE and the shooter reads it. 3s count 2. Fundamentals: Ball handling series and Alford Layups. Two-ball pounds, crossover, in and out, then finish with both hands. Eyes up, no looking at the ball. Horn at the end, stay at your basket.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, chair screen. Left: Fundamentals, ball handling into Alford layups.
visual.coach: Assistant B with the Shooters: feed the passer and keep the shot count. Assistant A with Fundamentals: call out eyes down and weak-hand finishes. Head coach floats, more time with Fundamentals.

items.title: Skill Stations, Round 2
items.note: Same groups, new drill. Shooters: Closeout Shooting. Partner passes from under the rim and closes out. Short closeout, shoot it. Hard closeout, one dribble middle into a pull up. A 3 counts 2, a pull up counts 1. Top pair runs the Victory Lap. Fundamentals: Footwork Shooting and USA Pivots. Jump stop, pivot, rip through, shoot. Last 3 minutes add a closeout. Strong pivots keep the ball safe.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, closeout shooting. Left: Fundamentals, jump stop and pivot.
visual.coach: Assistant B keeps the pair scores and calls bad closeouts. Assistant A passes to the Fundamentals group and checks the jump stop and pivot foot. Head coach floats.

items.title: Oregon Passing
items.note: Ball security. Good passes and talk. Call the name before you pass. 2-minute rounds, as many as we can, beat the last round. Bad pass or silent pass is a redo.

visual.label: Full court passing lines, finish at the rim.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline counting rounds out loud. Assistants call out any pass that is late or lands at the feet.

items.title: Closeout and Recover
items.note: 5 minutes 1v1 closeouts from help, 2 dribbles, games to 3. Then 5 minutes 2v2 help and recover: the helper stops the drive, then gets back to his man. Open kick-out 3 counts and the defense runs. Talk first or the stop does not count.

visual.label: 2v2: help stops the drive, recovers on the kick.
visual.coach: Head coach watches the helper: feet in the lane, then a short closeout. Assistant A under the rim rebounds and keeps the score.

items.title: Offense Reps: 5v0 to 3v3
items.note: 5 Out Pass and Cut. Three rules: pass and cut, fill the open spot, drive if nobody is open. 4 minutes 5v0: 10 passes with a cut and fill, no dribble. Then 7 minutes 3v3 at both baskets: layup off a cut is 2, a pass with no cut is a turnover. Defense plays pack line.

visual.label: Pass, cut to the rim, everyone fills.
visual.coach: Head coach at half court: yell stop, whoever is standing still says where he should be. Assistant A runs the far basket 3v3 and keeps the score.

items.title: Game 4v4
items.note: Team 1 vs Team 2, games to 7. Option A, Man Only: a talked stop is 2, a paint touch before the shot is worth 1 extra, a pass with no cut is a turnover. Winners run the Victory Lap. Option B, scrimmage graded on three things: help stops the drive, help recovers on the kick, and we cut after we pass.

visual.label: 4v4 with 8. Pack line on defense.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline keeping score and calling the grades out loud. Assistant A on the other sideline counts turnovers and baseline drives.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name. Round 1: any miss, the whole team runs. Round 2, Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally, champion picks the next Circle Up question. Reminder: captain votes to me before you leave. Break the huddle.

visual.coach: Head coach off the lane with the tally. Count it out loud and break the huddle. Assistants collect balls and cones.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 from the block, winner stays, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Knockout
extras.note: 2 balls. Free throw line, then elbow, then top of the key 3.

focus: Shell Stage 4, Closeouts Live, and the 1-3-1
tagline: Close out short. Force middle. Talk in the zone.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Captains first. I read the votes and I am naming our captains for the season. Captains lead warmup starting today. Union reminder: the Union college teams are here next week, hands up if you want the details. Today is our hardest day of the week. Sunday was Ball, Gap, Help. Tuesday was help and recover. Today the closeouts go live. Two non-negotiables: move on the flight of the pass, and talk every possession. Winners run is on. Split Team 1 / Team 2. Station groups: Shooters and Fundamentals.

visual.coach: Head coach in the middle: name the captains, Union next week, then the focus. Assistants set the cones on both sidelines for Syracuse.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup only, baseline to half court and back. Jog, high knees, butt kicks, carioca both ways, walking lunge with a twist, leg swings, defensive slides, two build-up sprints. Captains lead it and call each move. First day on the job: loud and on time.

visual.coach: Captains run it. Head coach on the sideline watching effort and how the captains lead. Assistants finish the Syracuse cones.

items.title: Syracuse: Set 1
items.note: One set today. FL, HC, BL with SH for shuffle and BP for backpedal. Team 1 vs Team 2. Partner rule: you are not done until your partner is done. The group calls the variation out loud before every rep. Losing team claps the winners in.

visual.label: Baseline to free throw line, half court and back. Sprint, shuffle, backpedal.
visual.coach: Head coach calls the set and keeps the team score. Assistant A on the far sideline checks the partner rule and that every foot touches the line.

items.title: Vegas Closeouts
items.note: One set. Defender starts in help, passes to the wing and closes out: sprint the first two-thirds, short chop steps, get low, two hands up. Shade him baseline so he has to go middle into the help. Offense gets 2 dribbles. Drive goes baseline and the defense loses the rep. Games to 3, winner runs the Victory Lap.

visual.coach: Assistant stands in the gap (Gap) as the help, so the drive middle runs into him. Head coach watches the last three steps: chop, low, two hands up, top foot high.

items.title: Teach: Shell Stage 4, Closeouts Live
items.note: Pack line. 2 minutes on the board, 8 on the floor. Stage 4 is live. Drive middle, help stops it, kick out, and the helper closes out short: sprint, chop, two hands up, shade baseline so he goes middle. Offense can shoot or drive. I yell freeze and ask one guy his job. Late rotation or a baseline drive, group runs a down and back. Stop plus a box out is a point for the defense.

visual.label: Drive, kick, the helper closes out short and forces middle.
visual.coach: Assistant B fills the right corner on offense. Assistant A at the board for 2 minutes, then a wing. Head coach above the top of the key: freeze, ask, grade the closeout.

items.title: 1-3-1 Zone Defense
items.note: New look. Same bottom man the whole block; I rotate guys through the middle and the wings. TOP pushes the ball to a side. WINGS trap with the top when it hits the wing, hands up in the passing lanes. MIDDLE fronts the high post and takes away the pass to the free throw line. BOTTOM runs baseline to baseline and takes every corner pass, then the far wing drops to the block. Walk it 5v0 first, then live against the other group. Every pass, everyone moves and talks.

visual.label: Corner pass: bottom takes the corner, far wing drops to the block.
visual.coach: Head coach on the left sideline: rotate the middle and the wings every 3 possessions, freeze and ask who has the corner. Assistant A on the right sideline counts trap turnovers and baseline catches.

items.title: Skill Stations + Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Two groups, horn at the end. Shooters at the main basket: 4 minutes Closeout Drives (games to 3), then jump stop catch and shoot, then one dribble pull ups. Feet set before the catch. Fundamentals at the far basket: Catch and Shoot, Feet First. Jump stop on two feet, elbow and short corner. Then spacing: stay about 15 feet apart, on a drive the two closest slide one spot away, catch ready to shoot. Pressure free throws rotate the whole block: coach calls a name, that player steps to the line, group freezes and says his name. Make both, 1 point on the tally. Any miss, his group runs a down and back.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, closeout drives and pull ups. Left: Fundamentals, catch and shoot and spacing. Free throw line: one shooter at a time.
visual.coach: Assistant B runs the Shooters and keeps the closeout scores. Assistant A runs Fundamentals and checks feet set and spacing. Head coach calls one name at a time to the line and keeps the free throw tally.

items.title: Oregon Passing
items.note: Ball security. Next week we beat pressure, so the passing starts now. Call the name before you pass. 2-minute rounds, beat the last round. Bad pass or silent pass is a redo.

visual.label: Full court passing lines, finish at the rim.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline counting rounds out loud. Assistants call out any pass that is late or lands at the feet.

items.title: Game Scrimmage 4v4
items.note: Team 1 vs Team 2, games to 7. Pack line on defense, Stage 4 rules. Every foul is two pressure free throws: the team says the shooter's name, make both and it counts plus 1 on the tally. Option A, Every Miss Is Ours: a stop with a box out is 2, a putback is 3, a baseline drive costs the defense 2. Option B, scrimmage graded on three things: closeout short and force middle, box out on every shot, touch the paint before we shoot. Last possession of each game, defense can call 1-3-1. Winners run the Victory Lap. Count the tally and break the huddle.

visual.label: 4v4 with 8. Pack line on defense, no baseline.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline keeping score and calling the grades out loud. Assistant A on the other sideline counts turnovers, baseline drives and offensive rebounds.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 from the block, winner stays, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Hot Shot
extras.note: 60 seconds, 5 spots worth 1 to 5. High score runs the Victory Lap.

focus: Game Ready: Pregame Routine, Pack Line and Beat the Trap
tagline: Warm up like it's game night. Force middle. Chin it in the trap.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: We scrimmage at 5:00, so this hour gets us game ready. First game is Thursday Nov 12 at KSD. Treat today like game day: loud, sharp, on time. Two non-negotiables: never get beat standing still, and talk every possession. In the scrimmage I grade three things: force middle, talk, and no panic when they trap. Split Team 1 / Team 2. Station groups: Shooters and Fundamentals.

visual.coach: Head coach in the middle: scrimmage at 5:00, first game Nov 12, the three things we grade. Assistants set the cones and grab a ball for every player.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup, the same one we do before games. Baseline to half court and back: jog, high knees, butt kicks, carioca both ways, walking lunge with a twist, leg swings, defensive slides, two build-up sprints. Captains lead it and call each move. Loud. This is how we walk out on Nov 12.

visual.coach: Captains run it. Head coach on the sideline watching energy, like it's game night. Assistants set out balls for the layups.

items.title: Game Day Layups and Kentucky Shooting
items.note: Our pregame routine. 5 minutes 60 Second Layups: one ball each, alternate hands, game speed, no lazy finishes. Then 5 minutes Kentucky Shooting: 3 lines of 3, middle up and half court. Feet set before the catch. Every make, the line calls it out.

visual.label: Layups first, then three lines at half court. Wings fill, middle drives up.
visual.coach: Assistant A under the rim rebounding and feeding the ball back out. Head coach on the sideline calling the switch from layups to Kentucky and the rotation.

items.title: Shell Drill: Stage 4
items.note: The defense we play at 5:00. Pack line, Stage 4, game speed. Ball, Gap, Help called out loud on every pass. Drive middle, help stops it, kick out, helper closes out short and forces middle. All five box out. Late rotation or a baseline drive, group runs a down and back. Stop plus a box out is a point for the defense.

visual.label: Drive, kick, the helper closes out short and forces middle.
visual.coach: Assistant B fills the right corner on offense. Assistant A plays a wing. Head coach above the top of the key: freeze, ask one guy his job, grade the closeout and the box out.

items.title: Teach: Beat the Trap
items.note: This week's install, short version. When two guys trap you: stop, chin the ball with two elbows out, pivot away from the pressure. Never dribble backward into the corner. Fake high, pass low. Teammates: the closest guy flashes to the middle, one comes back to meet it, one goes long. Walk it once, then two coaches trap at game speed. Each player gets 3 reps. Use it at 5:00.

visual.label: Two coaches trap the wing. Chin, pivot, the middle man flashes, pass out.
visual.coach: Assistants A and B are the trappers: hands high, active, no fouls. Head coach at the top of the key: walk it once, then count clean reps out of 3 and ask the flasher where he should be.

items.title: Skill Stations
items.note: Two groups, horn at the end. Shooters at the main basket: Closeout Shooting. Partner passes and closes out. Short closeout, shoot it. Hard closeout, one dribble middle into a pull up. A 3 counts 2, a pull up counts 1. Top pair runs the Victory Lap. Fundamentals at the far basket: Footwork Shooting and USA Pivots. Jump stop, pivot, rip through, shoot. Last 3 minutes add a closeout. Strong pivots keep the ball safe.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, closeout shooting. Left: Fundamentals, jump stop and pivot.
visual.coach: Assistant B with the Shooters: keep the pair scores and call bad closeouts. Assistant A with Fundamentals: pass to them and check the jump stop and pivot foot. Head coach floats, more time with Fundamentals.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name. Round 1: any miss, the whole team runs. Round 2, Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally. Then the scrimmage plan: force middle, talk, no panic in the trap. We count turnovers and baseline drives. Break the huddle at 5:00.

visual.coach: Head coach off the lane with the tally. Count it out loud, give the three things we grade, break the huddle at 5:00. Assistants grab the stat sheet for turnovers and baseline drives.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 from the block, winner stays, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Knockout
extras.note: 2 balls. Free throw line, then elbow, then top of the key 3.

focus: Press Break, Inbounds and a 5v5 Game
tagline: Ball to the middle. Know your spot. Hustle back.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Captains: you lead warmup and you set the tone. If the energy is low, that's on you first. Starting five: I name it before the game, and it gets earned here at practice. Our first game is Thursday Nov 12 at KSD. That's 9 days. Practice: every practice matters. If you can't make it, tell us before, not after. If you don't, your minutes get limited. That's not fair to your teammates, and it's not fair to us as coaches, to give this time and have you not show up. That is everyone. It doesn't matter who you are. These next few games I'm looking for defense: hustle back on defense, and play hard every minute you're out there. Today is the press break. Two non-negotiables: talk every possession, and never get beat standing still. Winners run is on. Split Team 1 / Team 2. Station groups: Shooters and Fundamentals.

visual.coach: Head coach in the middle: captains, starting five, KSD in 9 days, the attendance rule (tell us before or minutes get limited, everyone), and defense: hustle back. Assistants set the cones and grab a ball for every player.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: New warmup drills today. Coach leads them. Dynamic only, no shooting. Learn them today, because this becomes our game warmup. Loud and on time.

visual.coach: Head coach teaches the new warmup drills. Captains help keep the lines moving. Assistants set out balls and cones for Oregon Passing.

items.title: Oregon Passing
items.note: Ball security first. Call the name before you pass. Pass must hit the hands. 2-minute rounds, beat the last round. Bad pass or silent pass is a redo. This is the passing we need against the press.

visual.label: Call the name, pass to the hands, follow your pass.
visual.coach: Head coach counts passes out loud and calls redos on a silent or bad pass. Assistant A runs the clock on 2-minute rounds and calls the best round.

items.title: Press Break: Teach and Live
items.note: This week's install. 3 minutes on the board, then walk it. Inbounder takes it out fast, before the press sets. Two guards get open at the free throw line extended. One man flashes to the middle, one goes long past half court. Catch facing up the floor. Ball to the middle, then up. Never dribble into the corner: chin it, pivot, fake high and pass low. Inbounder steps in after the pass and is the safety. Walk it 5v0, then coaches press at half speed. Then live: 5 on offense against 3 players plus two coaches. Past half court in under 8 seconds is 1 point. Score after it is 2. Turnover or a 5-second call, the offense runs a down and back. Rotate every 3 trips. Goal: past half in 8, 4 out of 5.

visual.label: Our baseline is at the top. Walk it, then live: middle, then long. Past half in 8 seconds.
visual.coach: Assistants A and B press: half speed during the walk-through, then trap the first pass live, hands up, no fouls. Head coach on the sideline: walk it, freeze and ask where he should be, then count the 8 seconds out loud and keep score.

items.title: Skill Stations
items.note: Two groups, horn at the end. Shooters at the main basket: Catch, Rip and Go. Jump stop, rip low, one hard dribble to a layup. Add a closeout: if he runs at you, drive. If he sits, shoot. Fundamentals at the far basket: Ball handling series and Alford Layups. Two-ball pounds, crossover, in and out, finish with both hands. Eyes up. We need everyone able to handle pressure.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, catch, rip and go. Left: Fundamentals, ball handling and Alford layups.
visual.coach: Assistant B with the Shooters: feeds the pass and makes the closeout, mix running at them and sitting back. Assistant A with Fundamentals: calls the ball handling moves and checks eyes up. Head coach floats, more time with Fundamentals.

items.title: Inbounds: Duke and Line
items.note: Under our basket. Walk Duke, then Line, 5v0. Everyone says his spot before the ball is handed in. Then run each one live against coaches. Inbounder slaps the ball to start it. 5 seconds, so get there fast. A clean catch and a score is 2. A turnover, the group runs a down and back.

visual.label: Ball under our basket. Set up, say your spot, then run Duke or Line.
visual.coach: Assistants A and B defend in the lane during the live reps. Head coach on the sideline calls Duke or Line and checks that everyone knows his spot.

items.title: Game 5v5 (or 4v4)
items.note: Team 1 vs Team 2, full court, games to 7. 5v5 with coaches filling in, 4v4 if we're short. Pack line on defense. After every make, the scoring team presses. Every dead ball under our basket, run Duke or Line. Every foul is two pressure free throws: the team says the shooter's name, make both and it's 1 on the tally. Option A, scored for today: past half in under 8 seconds is a bonus point, a turnover against the press is 2 for the defense, a baseline drive costs the defense 2. Option B, scrimmage graded on three things: hustle back on defense, past half in 8, and box out on every shot. Winners run the Victory Lap. Count the tally and break the huddle.

visual.coach: Assistants A and B fill in to make it 5v5. Head coach on the sideline calls Option A or B, grades hustle back, and keeps the tally. If we're short, coaches step out and it's 4v4.

focus: Transition D and Pack Line Day
tagline: Sprint to the paint. Talk on everything. Pack line all day.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Today is our hardest day of the week. Two things. First: starting Sunday, practice focuses on defensive efficiency. That's what we track and what I'm watching: baseline drives, layups we give up in transition, offensive rebounds we give up, and talk. I want to see it today. Talk on everything: every screen, every pass, every shot. Second: today we sprint back to the paint, then we get a lot of pack line. First game is Thursday Nov 12 at KSD. That's one week. Two non-negotiables: talk every possession, and never get beat standing still. Split Team 1 / Team 2.

visual.coach: Head coach in the middle: Sunday's focus is defensive efficiency and what we track, talk on everything today, KSD in one week. Assistants grab balls and set up for Oregon Passing.

items.title: Game Warmup (timed, 12 minutes)
items.note: Our full game warmup, start to finish, on the clock. 12 minutes, the same as game night at KSD. Captains lead it and call each move. Dynamic only. Loud and on time. If we run over, we fix it today, not on game night. Coach: when it ends, ask them: to finish the game warmup, do you want shooting or 3v3? See which one gets us more ready.

visual.label: Full game warmup on a 12-minute clock. Captains call every move.
visual.coach: Head coach runs the 12-minute clock and calls the time out loud at 6 and 10. When it ends, ask the team: shooting or 3v3 to finish the game warmup? Assistants watch for lines that drag.

items.title: Oregon Passing
items.note: Ball security. Call the name before you pass. Pass must hit the hands. 2-minute rounds, beat the last round. Bad pass or silent pass is a redo. Talking starts here.

visual.label: Call the name, pass to the hands, follow your pass.
visual.coach: Head coach counts passes out loud and calls redos on a silent or bad pass. Assistant A runs the clock on 2-minute rounds and calls the best round.

items.title: Teach: Transition D, Sprint to the Paint
items.note: This week's last install. 2 minutes on the board, 10 on the floor. Pack line teams get back to the paint first. That's the rule. Shot goes up: three crash, two get back. Our top guard is always back. Turnover or a long rebound: everybody sprints. Turn and run, don't backpedal. Sprint to the paint first, not to your man. Protect the rim, then build the pack. First man back stops the ball early and yells BALL. Turn him middle, never let him go baseline. Everyone else fills the paint, then finds his man from the paint out. No layups, make them pass. What I want to see: all five sprinting, every time, and talking the whole way back. A lot of hustle. Walk it 5v0, then live: coach shoots, the other group pushes it back 4 on 4. Stop before a layup is a point for the defense. Give up a layup, the group runs a down and back.

visual.label: Ball coming at us from half court. First man back stops the ball. Everyone else sprints to the paint.
visual.coach: Assistant A at the board for 2 minutes, then pushes the ball up the floor during the walk-through. Assistant B fills in on offense in the live reps. Head coach at half court: count the guys in the paint out loud, freeze and ask who has the ball.

items.title: Shell Drill: Stage 4
items.note: Pack line, Stage 4, game speed. Ball, Gap, Help called out loud on every pass. Drive middle, help stops it, kick out, helper closes out short and forces middle. All five box out. New today: on the rebound, the defense outlets and the offense sprints back to the paint before the coach counts 3. Late rotation or a baseline drive, the group runs a down and back. Stop plus a box out is a point.

visual.label: Stage 4 live. Box out, then sprint back after the rebound.
visual.coach: Assistant B fills the right corner on offense. Assistant A plays a wing. Head coach above the top of the key: freeze and ask one guy his job, grade the closeout and the box out, count 3 on the sprint back.

items.title: Pack Line vs the Pick and Roll
items.note: New for the pack line. 2 minutes on the board, 8 on the floor. The screener's man calls it early and loud: SCREEN LEFT or SCREEN RIGHT. He jumps out, shows his body, and slows the ball for two dribbles. Ball defender goes over the top of the screen and stays attached. The show man gets back to his man as soon as the ball defender is back. Everyone else stays in the pack. The low helper tags the roller. Force middle into help. Never let the ball turn the corner to the baseline. Start 2v2 Screen Defense: talk first or the rep doesn't count. Games to 5. Then 4v4 in the half court with a ball screen on every possession.

visual.label: Screener's man shows. Ball defender over the top. Low helper tags the roller.
visual.coach: Assistant A sets the ball screens in the 2v2 and the 4v4. Assistant B plays the ball handler when we need a body. Head coach above the top of the key: no call, no rep. Freeze and ask who tags the roller.

items.title: Closeout Shooting
items.note: Defense and shots up at the same time. Pairs. Partner passes and closes out: sprint, chop, two hands up, push him middle. Short closeout, shoot it. Hard closeout, one dribble middle into a pull up. A 3 counts 2, a pull up counts 1. Switch every 5 shots. Top pair at the horn wins.

visual.label: Close out short, push him middle. Short closeout: shoot. Hard closeout: one dribble middle.
visual.coach: Assistant A at the main basket and Assistant B at the far basket: rebound, keep the pair scores, call bad closeouts. Head coach floats and watches the last three steps of every closeout.

items.title: Inbounds: Box Man, Square, Box Zone
items.note: Under our basket. Walk Box Man, then Square, then Box Zone, 5v0. Everyone says his spot before the ball is handed in. Box Man is against man. Box Zone is against a zone. Then live against coaches. Inbounder slaps the ball to start it. 5 seconds, so get there fast. A clean catch and a score is 2. A turnover, the group runs a down and back.

visual.label: Ball under our basket. Set up, say your spot, then run Box Man, Square or Box Zone.
visual.coach: Assistants A and B defend in the lane during the live reps, in man for Box Man and Square, in a zone for Box Zone. Head coach on the sideline calls the play and checks that everyone knows his spot.

items.title: Game 4v4 (or 5v5)
items.note: Team 1 vs Team 2, full court, games to 7. 4v4 with eight, coaches fill in for 5v5. Pack line on defense. Every miss, the defense sprints back to the paint. Every dead ball under our basket, run Box Man, Square or Box Zone. Every foul is two pressure free throws: the team says the shooter's name, make both and it's 1 on the tally. Option A, scored for today: a stop in transition is 2 for the defense, a layup given up in transition costs the defense 2, a baseline drive costs the defense 2. Option B, scrimmage graded on three things: sprint to the paint, talk on every screen, and box out on every shot. Count the tally.

visual.label: Live game. Every miss, sprint back to the paint.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline: calls Option A or B, keeps score and the tally. Assistant A counts transition layups given up and baseline drives. Assistant B counts offensive rebounds and screens with no call. If we're 5v5, both assistants step in.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name. Round 1: any miss, the whole team runs. Round 2, Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally. Champion picks the next Circle Up question. Break the huddle.

visual.coach: Head coach off the lane with the tally: count it out loud and break the huddle. Assistants collect balls and the stat counts.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 from the block, winner stays, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Knockout
extras.note: 2 balls. Free throw line, then elbow, then top of the key 3.

focus: Defensive Efficiency, plus Drive and Kick Decisions
tagline: No baseline. Box out. Drive it, kick it.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Starting today, practice focuses on defensive efficiency. Four things we track: baseline drives, layups we give up in transition, offensive rebounds we give up, and talk. I count them today. Our new install is drive and kick: when to drive, when to kick, when to shoot. First game is Thursday at KSD. Two non-negotiables: talk every possession, and never get beat standing still. Winners run is on. Split Team 1 / Team 2. Station groups: Shooters and Fundamentals.

visual.coach: Head coach in the middle: defensive efficiency and the four things we count, today's install, KSD on Thursday. Assistants grab balls and set up for Oregon Passing.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Our game warmup, dynamic only. Captains lead it and call each move. Loud and on time. Same warmup we walk out with on Thursday.

visual.label: Dynamic warmup, baseline to half court and back. Captains call every move.
visual.coach: Captains run it. Head coach on the sideline watching energy and the clock. Assistants set out balls for Oregon Passing.

items.title: Oregon Passing
items.note: Ball security. Call the name before you pass. Pass must hit the hands. 2-minute rounds, beat the last round. Bad pass or silent pass is a redo.

visual.label: Call the name, pass to the hands, follow your pass.
visual.coach: Head coach counts passes out loud and calls redos on a silent or bad pass. Assistant A runs the clock on 2-minute rounds and calls the best round.

items.title: Teach: Drive and Kick, Attack the Closeout
items.note: Today's install. 2 minutes on the board, 10 on the floor. Stay about 15 feet apart. Drive the gap. On a drive, the two closest slide one spot away. Helper comes: kick it. Nobody comes: finish. Catching the kick: if he runs at you, drive. If he sits, shoot. Touch the paint before any shot. Walk it 4 on 0, then speed, then live 4v4. Freeze and ask: who helped, where does the ball go?

visual.label: Drive the gap. The helper comes, kick it. The two closest slide one spot away.
visual.coach: Assistant A at the board for 2 minutes, then plays defense in the live 4v4. Assistant B plays defense and closes out hard or sits back so the shooter has to read it. Head coach above the top of the key: freeze and ask who helped and where the ball goes.

items.title: Skill Stations
items.note: Two groups, horn at the end. Shooters at the main basket: Closeout Drives. Defender passes and closes out, offense gets 2 dribbles. Games to 3. Drive him middle into help, never baseline. Fundamentals at the far basket: Catch, Rip and Go. Jump stop, rip low, one hard dribble to a layup. Add a closeout: if he runs at you, drive. If he sits, shoot.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, closeout drives. Left: Fundamentals, catch, rip and go.
visual.coach: Assistant B with the Shooters: keep the games to 3 and call any closeout that gives up baseline. Assistant A with Fundamentals: feed the pass and make the closeout, mix running at them and sitting back. Head coach floats.

items.title: Rebounding Toughness
items.note: Offensive rebounds we give up are one of our four numbers. 3v3, coach shoots, offense crashes. Find your man, hit first, two hands, chin it, outlet. Defense needs 3 straight boards to get off. An offensive board resets you to zero. Five boxing out every time.

visual.label: Coach shoots. Hit first, hold him, two hands on the ball.
visual.coach: Head coach shoots from the top. Assistant A counts straight boards for the defense and resets on an offensive board. Assistant B runs the second group at the far basket if we split.

items.title: Shell Drill: Stage 4
items.note: Pack line, Stage 4, game speed, right after rebounding so we're tired. Ball, Gap, Help called out loud on every pass. Drive middle, help stops it, kick out, helper closes out short and forces middle. All five box out. A baseline drive or a late rotation, the group runs a down and back. Stop plus a box out is a point for the defense.

visual.label: Drive, kick, the helper closes out short and forces middle.
visual.coach: Assistant B fills the right corner on offense. Assistant A plays a wing. Head coach above the top of the key: freeze and ask one guy his job, count baseline drives and late rotations.

items.title: Game 4v4 (or 5v5)
items.note: Team 1 vs Team 2, full court, games to 7. 4v4 with eight, coaches fill in for 5v5. Pack line on defense. Every miss, sprint back to the paint. Every foul is two pressure free throws: the team says the shooter's name. Can-do check: one full 4-minute half with zero baseline drives. Option A, scored for today: a layup off a kick or a drive is 2, a baseline drive costs the defense 2, an offensive board given up costs the defense 1. Option B, scrimmage graded on three things: no baseline drives, box out every shot, touch the paint before we shoot. Winners run the Victory Lap.

visual.label: Live game. Force middle, box out, sprint back on a miss.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline: calls Option A or B, runs the 4-minute clock for the can-do check, keeps score. Assistant A counts baseline drives and transition layups given up. Assistant B counts offensive rebounds given up. If we're 5v5, both assistants step in.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name. Round 1: any miss, the whole team runs. Round 2, Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally. Give them today's four numbers. Champion picks the next Circle Up question. Break the huddle.

visual.coach: Head coach off the lane with the tally and today's four numbers from the assistants. Break the huddle. Assistants collect balls.

extras.note: 1v1 from the block, winner stays, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.
